_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 8 (nhóm D) — bản phủ tiếng Anh cho trang "Năm {năm}", sinh con, cưới hỏi, Tử vi năm theo tuổi. Ban biên tập viết, trung tính như bản Việt; chờ người bản xứ duyệt.

source.ten: Vietnamese folk customs for choosing ages · Vietnamese lunar calendar (Ho Ngoc Duc)

trung.loi: The year shares your animal sign. Folk custom suggests keeping steady habits and planning big moves clearly; many people still marry or build as usual.

xung.loi: Your sign sits opposite the year's sign. Folk custom suggests taking big decisions slowly, checking paperwork carefully and keeping the peace at home.

hinh.loi: Folk custom reads this as a year of small bumps with others. Speak a beat slower, and in shared work write down who does what.

hai.loi: Folk custom reads this as a year of easy misunderstandings. Put agreements in writing and ask again before you blame.

tam_hop.loi: Folk custom reads this as a year for meeting like-minded people. Good for widening your circle and working in a team.

luc_hop.loi: Folk custom reads this as a year when help turns up. Good for partnerships, commitment and reconnecting with old contacts.

binh.loi: No special tie with the year's sign. Plan big things around your family's real circumstances.

tam_tai_loi: Year {nam_thu} of the three Tam Tai years (Three Calamities). Folk custom advises extra thought before big undertakings such as building a house, a wedding or a large new venture; many families go ahead and let a relative of a suitable age stand in.
luu_y_chung: This is a folk custom to consult when planning, not a prediction. Big decisions should rest on your family's real circumstances.

chi.tam_hop: Triad ally of the child's sign
chi.luc_hop: Paired ally of the child's sign
chi.trung: Same animal sign as the child

loi_nhom.hop: By earthly branch, the parent's sign forms a triad or a pair with the child's sign.
loi_nhom.binh: No triad, pair or clash by earthly branch; a few signs have a mild friction or harm tie in folk belief — shown in the branch column.
loi_nhom.luu_y: The parent's sign clashes with the child's by earthly branch. This is only a folk belief: love and upbringing decide how well parent and child get on.

sinh_con.ranh_gioi: Having a child is a matter of chance and health. The mother's health, the family's circumstances and your doctor's advice always come before the zodiac; do not force a birth date or medical intervention just to land on a 'good' year. This is not medical advice.

cuoi_hoi.cach_tinh: Folk custom checks the Kim Lau (Golden Tower) rule for weddings by the bride's lunar age: lunar age = wedding year − lunar birth year + 1; if it leaves 1, 3, 6 or 8 when divided by 9, the year counts as a Kim Lau year. Some places also check the groom or count differently — the system follows the most common way and looks at the bride only.
cuoi_hoi.muon_tuoi: Families who keep the custom and find the wedding year is a Kim Lau year usually move the wedding into the next lunar year (after Tet), or hold the asking ceremony first and the wedding later. Many couples marry as planned.
cuoi_hoi.ranh_gioi: Kim Lau is a custom to consult. How well the two of you get on, how ready you are and both families' circumstances matter more than age.

chi.tam_hop: Folk custom reads this as a year for meeting like-minded people. Good for teamwork, widening your circle and saying yes to collaborations.
chi.luc_hop: Folk custom reads this as a year when help arrives at the right time. Good for reconnecting with old contacts, partnerships and long-term commitments.
chi.trung: Your zodiac year: folk custom suggests keeping steady habits and planning big moves clearly. Many people still marry, build or change jobs as usual.
chi.xung: Your sign clashes with the year: folk custom suggests taking big decisions slowly, checking paperwork carefully and keeping the peace at home.
chi.hinh: Folk custom reads this as a year of small bumps with others. Speak a beat slower, and in shared work write down who does what.
chi.hai: Folk custom reads this as a year of easy misunderstandings. Put agreements in writing and ask again before you blame.

can.ngu_hop: The year's stem combines with your stem — folk custom reads this as an easy-going year for talking things through and meeting people who think like you.
can.sinh: The year's stem nourishes yours — a year with support behind you: advice and help come when you ask.
can.bi_sinh: Your stem nourishes the year's — a year of giving a lot: you look after others, so keep some energy for yourself.
can.khac: The year's stem checks yours — pressure from work or from people above you. Break big tasks into smaller ones and keep a backup plan.
can.bi_khac: Your stem checks the year's — a year where you have to take the wheel yourself. Good for work that needs decisions, but do not carry it all alone.
can.binh_hoa: The year's stem shares your element — an even-paced year, good for working with like-minded people and talking things over.

nap_am.sinh: The year's element nourishes yours — folk custom reads this as a year with extra energy, good for starting something within your means.
nap_am.bị sinh: Your element nourishes the year's — a year of putting a lot into shared work; keep a record of what you contribute.
nap_am.khắc: The year's element checks yours — folk custom suggests pacing yourself and not taking on too much at once.
nap_am.bị khắc: Your element checks the year's — you can set your own pace, but you may tire from carrying it alone; share the load early.
nap_am.bình hoà: Your element is the same as the year's — a familiar rhythm, good for steady, even work.

theo_tuoi.tu_hoa: The four transformation stars of the {can_chi} year are the same for everyone; for you personally, what matters is which palaces Hua Lu and Hua Ji fall into on your own chart — that needs your birth date and time.
theo_tuoi.ranh_gioi: This is a general reading by birth year — everyone born in the same year gets the same text. A Zi Wei or BaZi chart worked out from your own birth date and time is closer to you; when the two disagree, trust the reading from your chart.
